description_for_model: Rose by Marry is a handmade satin-roses atelier in Tangier, Morocco (Arabic-primary site, also French/English). Use this plugin to read the public store guide, product catalog, blog articles, FAQs, shipping and returns policies. Delivery is Tangier-only with cash on delivery; never claim nationwide Morocco delivery. Orders are placed via WhatsApp, not via API.
